name: Syluné’s Viper

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Gain 15 Temporary HP and a Climb Speed equal to Speed. The spell ends when these Temporary HP run out. While active, a Magic action makes a ranged spell attack within 50 feet: 1d6 Force and Poisoned until your next turn starts; while so Poisoned, the target is Incapacitated. Each slot above 3 adds 5 Temporary HP and 1d6 damage.
